BiblicalUsage: Melatiah is a Gibeonite who came home from exile and put his hands to the wall. Nehemiah 3:7 says he repaired the wall next to Jadon the Meronothite, men of Gibeon and Mizpah, working up to the governor's seat on this side of the river.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wall went up because returned exiles and old neighbours worked side by side, each in his own stretch.
